text:
anna: noticed p99 spike on tiny responses after the recent kernel selector tweak — 1-4 token requests up ~3x.

leo: any flame/profile?

anna: quick perf: memcpy_small ~45%, grpc_readv ~18%, tokenizer_split ~12%, wide_kernel_prep ~9%

maria: sounds like two issues: proxy fragmenting into tiny syscalls and selector picking wide path that does extra prep on kv-miss.

leo: mitigation: toggle proxy coalesce (runtime flag) and add a selector guard: if tokens<=8 && kv_hit_rate<0.6 prefer narrow kernel.

maria: i'll flip coalesce on a canary and add metric host.rpc.coalesce.effective_bytes. also we'll add a trace span around memcpy_small to find allocation sites.

ci-bot: deploy: host-runtime v3.14.0 -> v3.14.1 (canary: 3 hosts)

anna: after coalesce + kernel guard p99 down to near baseline on canary. planning follow-ups: small-buffer arena for proto unpack + selector cost estimator that includes host-side work.

leo: thanks — file follow-ups and we can remove runtime knobs after arena lands.
